en.headline: Customs warns against XPower wireless power bank over burn risk
en.dek: Tests found the M10C+ model can overheat above 85 degrees Celsius when metal objects are placed between the charger and a device; 220 units were seized and sales banned.
body: Hong Kong Customs on Monday urged the public to stop using an XPower external charger with wireless charging function after safety tests showed a risk of overheating and burns.

The model, identified as the XPower M10C+ 6 in 1 Magnetic Wireless Power Bank 10000mAh, failed the burn test. When a metal object was placed between the charger and the device being charged, temperatures reached between 86.6 and 131.4 degrees Celsius, exceeding the 85-degree limit.

Officers earlier seized 220 units from a retailer and issued a prohibition notice barring further sales. Patrols across the city found no other stocks of the product on sale. The case remains under investigation.
Customs advised consumers to choose reputable brands with built-in short-circuit, over-charge and overheating protection, and to use original charging cables.

zh.headline: 海關籲停用XPower無線尿袋 測出過熱燒傷風險
zh.dek: 測試顯示該款M10C+充電器在金屬外物夾於中間時溫度可達86.6至131.4度，超過限值；已檢獲220件並禁售。
body: 香港海關周一呼籲市民停用一款具備無線充電功能的XPower外置充電器，因安全測試顯示有過熱及燒傷風險。
涉事型號為XPower M10C+ 6 in 1 Magnetic Wireless Power Bank 10000mAh。測試發現，當金屬外物放置於充電器與被充裝置之間時，外物溫度介乎攝氏86.6至131.4度，超過允許的85度限值，充電器亦會過熱，未能通過燒傷測試。
海關早前從一間零售商檢獲220件該款充電器，並向商戶發出禁制通知書，禁止繼續出售。全港巡查暫未發現其他存貨，案件仍在調查中。
海關建議市民選購信譽良好品牌、設有短路、過充及過熱保護的充電器，並使用原廠充電線。
